toolAnalysis.toolDescription:
Returns comprehensive details for a workitem, incident, or project including:
    - Basic attributes (title, status, product info, etc.)
    - Direct ediProd URL in the metadata block
    - Description and notes
    - The list of related workitems, incidents, and projects
    - Related issues (issueId, issueNumber, issueMessage)
    - Conversation history with clients (for incidents)
    - Attached documents

inputParameter.description: A unique number of workitem (starts with WI), incident (starts with CS), or project (starts with PRJ)

expectedResponseSections: Basic Attributes: title, status, product info, area, module, changeType, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt
Metadata: ediProd URL, system identifiers, version info
Description and Notes: full text descriptions and work notes
Related Items: related workitems, incidents, and projects
Related Issues: issueId (GUID), issueNumber, issueMessage (use get-issue-details for full occurrence data)
Conversation History: client conversation history (for incidents)
Attachments: attached documents with ediprod:/// URLs
License Info: server code, licence type, host server name, host database name, version (for incidents)

fallbackMethods: Use EDI-Prod-lookup-workitem-priorities to verify valid priority values
Check EDI-Prod-filter-workitems response for priority field
priority.notes: Priority is typically a required field in work item systems

defectIntroducedWI.description: The work item that introduced this defect (root cause traceability)
fallbackMethods: Query related workitems section for entries marked as 'defect-cause' or 'introduced-by'
Use EDI-Prod-filter-workitems with changeType=FIX to find defect fixes
Check if defectIntroducedWI is stored in related workitems with specific relationship type
defectIntroducedWI.notes: May only be populated for fix-type workitems; defect discovery items may not have this field

defectIntroducedCI.format: CI identifier or build number (varies by system)
defectIntroducedCI.description: The CI build or commit that introduced the defect
fallbackMethods: Use EDI-Prod-get-job-workflows to get workflow details which may include build info
Check workflow metadata for releaseGroup or build identifiers
Query related issues for exception stack traces that may reference CI/build
defectIntroducedCI.notes: This field may not be present in all systems; availability depends on CI/CD integration level

relatedIncidents.type: array of strings | list of objects
relatedIncidents.description: List of customer-reported incidents related to this work item
expectedLocation: response.relatedIssues (may need filtering for incident type)
fallbackMethods: Check response.relatedWorkitems section for items starting with 'CS'
Use EDI-Prod-get-job-workflows and check for incident references
relatedIncidents.notes: Related incidents link work items to customer-reported issues and are critical for traceability

invocationInstructions.step: Execute these 10 tool calls in sequence or in parallel
invocationInstructions.expectedResponseType: JSON object containing complete work item details
processingNotes: Each call should return independent results
Calls can be made in parallel for efficiency
Parse each response for the 4 target fields
Document which fields are present vs. absent
Note any alternative field names or locations

priority.rule: Must be a non-empty string or enum value
priority.validation: Check if field exists and is not null/empty

defectIntroducedCI.validation: Check if field exists and is not null/empty

relatedIncidents.rule: Must be array/list of CS##### format strings or objects with incident references
relatedIncidents.validation: Check if array/list, validate each item matches CS##### pattern
relatedIncidents.note: Can be empty list if no related incidents

successCriteria: All 10 work items return valid JSON responses
Response includes at least the 4 target fields (or alternative field names)
Field values are accessible via documented extraction paths
Related items sections are properly populated
No authentication or access errors occur
partialSuccessCriteria: 7-9 out of 10 work items return successfully
2-3 target fields are found in responses
Fallback methods can retrieve missing fields
minimalSuccessCriteria: At least 5 work items return successfully
At least 1 target field is found
Tool structure and response format are validated

EDI-Prod-lookup-workitem-priorities.purpose: Get valid priority values to validate 'priority' field
EDI-Prod-lookup-workitem-priorities.usage: Call if priority values are unclear or need validation

EDI-Prod-get-issue-details.purpose: Get full issue details including related defect information
EDI-Prod-get-issue-details.usage: Call with issueId from relatedIssues section to get more details

EDI-Prod-get-job-workflows.purpose: Get workflow and build information including CI/build details
EDI-Prod-get-job-workflows.usage: Call if defectIntroducedCI is not in main response

EDI-Prod-filter-incidents.purpose: Search for related incidents by work item
EDI-Prod-filter-incidents.usage: Fallback to find related incidents if not in main response

EDI-Prod-filter-workitems.purpose: Get work item list with priority and other standard fields
EDI-Prod-filter-workitems.usage: Validate field presence across multiple work items

responseStructureTemplate.description: Expected JSON structure from EDI-Prod-get-job-details response
responseStructureTemplate.title: string
responseStructureTemplate.notes: string or array of note objects

conclusionAndRecommendation.recommendation: EDI-Prod-get-job-details is the appropriate tool for retrieving all 4 target fields. Invoke it for all 10 work items. Use fallback methods only if specific fields are missing from responses.
